title: Yoisaki Kanade — Mouthpiece Challenge!〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Main Street

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Our after-party this time around was really fun♪ Especially because they were having that cake fair. We got to try so many different types!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Their mini cake platter was pretty incredible. Each one was only bite-sized, but they were stacked into a pyramid.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah! It was super photogenic, so I'm really glad we took the dive and ordered it.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Oh...
There's a crowd gathered over there.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: You're right. I also thought I heard someone ring a bell just now.

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line: We're holding a drawing to celebrate our grand reopening! Show us your receipt and you'll receive a number of attempts based on the total!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, right. That building was under construction for a really long time.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, it used to be mostly restaurants and stuff. But now, it looks like it's all apparel shops.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, I didn't know that...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Still, do those receipt lotteries usually draw that big a crowd?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Not sure, but you two won your tickets for Shibuya Instrument Day through one of these, right, Kanade?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, but we didn't go shopping with it in mind. We just happened to come across it on our way out.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
I mean, that's pretty normal.
Unless they have something really good up for grabs.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hey...!
se_run_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: E-Ena?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Why'd you start running like that all of a sudden?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Take a look at what the second-place prize is!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Let's see...
A pair of tickets to have the full course at Eden Fruit Parlor?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: My mom and I talked about how great it'd be to go here even just once in our lives.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Their full course is so popular that they're always booked up a year in advance.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: What? A whole year?

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line: Oh, are you interested in the tickets to Eden?

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line: The winner of these will be allowed to make a special reservation during the next three months.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What?! That's amazing!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Whoa, hook, line and sinker.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Weren't you just saying that these drawings don't do a good job of attracting customers?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Haha...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hey, since we're here, why don't we have a look around? I gotta work off all the cake I just ate.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah, we get it.
You wanna buy enough stuff to get a chance at those tickets, right?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: What do you think, Mafuyu?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I don't mind either way.
But the odds of you winning those tickets are low.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hey, don't rain on my parade before it's had a chance to even begin!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Seriously...
Just you wait! I'm gonna win them!
A few hours later

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line: Okay, based on the total on your receipt, you qualify for two attempts!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Parlor! Parlor! Parlor...!

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line:
Alright, we have...!
White! The consolation prize, a coupon for one of our shops!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Grr...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, I get that this is their last day, but that doesn't make it any easier to win their second prize.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But she still has one attempt left.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You won those tickets to Shibuya Instrument Day, right, Kanade? Gimme a hand here.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh? Like this...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Whoa...! E-Ena?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I wanna win those tickets, so share some of your luck with me, Kanade!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: O-Okay...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Share some of her luck with you?
Life would be a lot nicer if all it took to share good luck was holding hands.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Just shut up and watch, will you?

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line: Okay, please make your final spin.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (The blue ball is the one for second prize.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade & Mizuki
rows.Line: *Gasp*

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: That's the one...!

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line:
Congratulations!
You've won our second-place prize! A pair of tickets to have the full course at Eden Fruit Parlor!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Her luck ploy actually worked.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Y-Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Okay, Kanade, the next time I enter into a ticket lottery for an event, you gotta let me hold your hand.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Haha...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Kanade!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Thank you so much!
Now I can go like I've been dreaming!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I don't know how much I actually helped, but congratulations, Ena.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Are you kidding? You played a huge role.
In return, I'm gonna bring back lots of treats for you!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Hehe. Then, I'll be looking forward to seeing what you bring back. I hope you enjoy yourself.
